text: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 16.4%, down 140 basis points year on year, primarily on weaker petrochemical spreads. Polymer deltas remained under pressure through the quarter and we do not expect a meaningful recovery before the second half of FY25.

Net debt increased to 1.28 lakh crore rupees from 1.11 lakh crore in the prior quarter, driven by continued capital expenditure in the new energy business. Management guided to a further 45,000 crore of capex over the next four quarters.

source_name: Reliance SEBI Related Party Disclosure FY24
text: The Audit Committee reviewed related party transactions aggregating 8,940 crore rupees during the financial year. Two transactions involving the new energy subsidiary were flagged for enhanced disclosure following an internal review.

Constant currency revenue growth came in at 7.9% year on year, ahead of our guided range. Operating margin expanded 90 basis points sequentially to 24.3%, supported by improved utilisation and a favourable revenue mix in BFSI. Attrition declined for the fourth consecutive quarter to 12.1%.

Total contract value of deals signed during the quarter was 11.2 billion dollars, the highest in eight quarters, including two deals above 500 million dollars. The order book provides revenue visibility into the first half of FY26.
Free cash flow conversion stood at 98.4% of net income for the year. Cash and equivalents at year end were 62,300 crore rupees with no material long term borrowings.

Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter was negative 42 crore rupees, an improvement from negative 168 crore in the prior year period but still short of our stated breakeven timeline. Contribution margin in food delivery was 3.1% of gross order value, below the 4.5% internal target.

Monthly transacting users declined 2.4% sequentially to 17.4 million, the first sequential decline since listing. Management attributed this to reduced discounting intensity and a deliberate shift toward higher value orders.

source_name: Zomato SEBI Quarterly Disclosure Q2 FY24
text: The company disclosed a contingent liability of 803 crore rupees relating to an ongoing goods and services tax assessment covering July 2017 to March 2022. The company intends to contest the assessment through appellate channels.
